title: TFMG Liquid Train Fuels
description: Adds TFMG refinery fuels as liquid fuel for Create: Steam ’n’ Rails Neoforge.
body:
# TFMG Rail Fuels

Adds selected **The Factory Must Grow** refinery fluids as liquid train fuels for **Create: Steam ’n’ Rails**.

This is a small datapack for players who want TFMG’s fuel production chain to integrate with liquid-fueled locomotives.

## Included fuels

| Fluid | Fuel ticks per 100 mB |
|---|---:|
| Propane | 700 |
| Butane | 800 |
| Naphtha | 900 |
| Kerosene | 1050 |
| Gasoline | 1150 |
| Diesel | 1250 |
| LPG | 1300 |

> ⚠️ Requires **Realism mode enabled** in Steam ’n’ Rails config!

## Balance notes

The values are arranged as a progression from lighter/less efficient fuels to stronger refinery products:

- **Propane** and **Butane** are early/low-tier train fuels.
- **Naphtha** and **Kerosene** sit in the middle.
- **Gasoline**, **Diesel**, and **LPG** are the strongest options in this datapack.

## Required mods

- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- [Create: Steam ’n’ Rails Neoforge](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails-1.21.1)
- [The Factory Must Grow](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-tfmg)

## Installation

1. Download the `.zip`.
2. Put it into your world’s `datapacks` folder:
   - Singleplayer: `.minecraft/saves/<world>/datapacks/`
   - Server: `<server>/world/datapacks/`
3. Run `/reload`.

## Notes

This datapack assumes the TFMG fluid IDs use the format `tfmg:<name>`, for example `tfmg:diesel`.
